initialFailure.cause: Bounded verification evidence projects sourceWorkId/sourceVersionId to workId/versionId. Initial new audit failed to recognize the projected identity and skipped cross-source validation. Adapted both exact field representations; assertions unchanged.

checks: New server contract is immutable and clients cannot disable it; absent legacy contract remains disabled.
Cross-source/version or multiple bound table-row targets require an internal comparisonAudit in addition to a semantic passed verdict.
Premises bind only each target's own exact visible quotations/context and cover its source/version identities. Foreign, missing or altered quote bindings fail.
Unknown alignment cannot carry a fabricated differences list. Demonstrated differences require two literal source-bound values of the named condition; identical values fail.
Within-study numerical comparisons retain original table cell identities and independent numeric/table checks.
A valid audit does not override an independent failed semantic verdict; structural checks do not establish the meaning or completeness of experimental alignment.
Evidence aliases are restored only in typed audit IDs, preserving exact quote text and original records.
Single-source noncomparative facts and prospective proposals receive no additional audit requirement or extra model request.
Synthesis and factual repair qualify the user's comparison premise, lead with judgement and limits, preserve metric directions and distinguish unknown alignment from demonstrated differences.
Saved repair requests cannot be retargeted to a different comparison contract after an unknown transport.
Actual legacy D5-v5 verification request fingerprint matches exactly; its historical verdict remains unchanged. Copied legacy passed response without the new audit fails the new contract.

budgetsUnchanged.note: Audit is part of the existing independent verification request. Its full input is reserved; role output caps and total budget stay unchanged.

boundary: Offline fixtures and copied exact real-input replay. New real content must be reviewed separately; no independent pass or whole-design completion credit.
